agreement.title: Quoto — User Agreement & Privacy
agreement.summary: By using Quoto in this group you accept the terms below.

sections.heading: What Quoto does
sections.text: During the day I read messages sent in this group and, at the set time, publish one “quote of the day”.

sections.heading: What is processed
sections.text: To choose the quote of the day I process:
items: media: photos, videos, voice and audio
the author's name and Telegram ID

sections.heading: AI processing
sections.text: To choose a quote, message text and media are sent to our AI provider OpenRouter and its model providers for analysis.
sections.note: Don't share passwords or sensitive data in chats where Quoto is active.

sections.heading: Storage
sections.text: The day's primary data is cleared after processing. Limited service records and processing results may be kept longer for reliability, quality checks, and statistics; published quotes and basic identifiers remain in the service history.

sections.heading: Your data
sections.text: I don't sell your data. To request deletion, contact {contact}.

sections.heading: Admin responsibility
sections.text: By accepting, a group admin confirms they may add this bot and that members know the chat is processed by Quoto.

sections.heading: As-is
sections.text: The service is provided “as is”, without warranties, and the terms may change; continued use means acceptance.
